My husband and I were the first guests to arrive for the Valentine’s Day special event. We booked this experience specifically because the event was advertised as including unlimited drinks and a live performance by SWV.

Upon arrival, we were seated in a section designated as VIP. However, we were later informed that at 11:00 PM we would need to vacate our table because SWV would be seated in that section. Shortly after, we were also told that the “unlimited drinks” advertised had now been reduced to only four drinks per person.
Not to mention the ladies restroom was not functional they had plumbers there working on the restroom during a packed audience.

Another couple seated next to us expressed the same concerns. When I questioned the owner about the change, he stated that due to TABC laws they could not offer unlimited drinks. However, this contradicts what was clearly advertised. If there were legal limitations, that should have been communicated upfront rather than changing the terms after guests had already paid and arrived. The advertisement felt misleading, and it was unfair to collect payment under one promise and deliver something entirely different.

The discussion escalated unnecessarily, as the owner began arguing with both myself and another guest regarding the advertisement. Following that exchange, service noticeably declined. Drinks and appetizers took an excessive amount of time to arrive. As more guests arrived, many voiced similar frustrations regarding the misleading promotion.

The entire evening felt chaotic and uncomfortable. Some guests did not receive their food at all and were told the restaurant had run out of salmon, which was listed as a featured entrée. However, approximately 45 minutes later, I personally observed a server delivering a salmon entrée to another table.

Overall, this was not the romantic, organized Valentine’s experience that was advertised or expected. We left feeling extremely disappointed. This is not a venue we would recommend for a special occasion, particularly one as meaningful as Valentine’s Day.

# Review of the February 14th Valentine's Day Dinner Featuring SWV

This review pertains to the Valentine's Day dinner held on February 14th, which featured a special appearance by SWV. As many have mentioned, the meal service was quite chaotic. On a positive note, the band TMarsh was fantastic and truly maintained a lively atmosphere; we thoroughly enjoyed their performance. The DJ also did a commendable job.

The lounge area was beautifully set up and decorated, and we were absolutely delighted with our table location. SWV made their appearance as promised, which was a highlight. The staff remained incredibly polite and composed, despite the pressure and chaos surrounding the food situation. They held it together admirably. Therefore, I give Fusion some credit for their effort.
Mostly likely we will think 2x before a revisit but its not completely off the table. Hopefully, they will regroup and move forward. We actually like the place.
